edges.rationale: Navbar component is the default export defined in Navbar.jsx.
performSearch filters ALL_SEARCHABLE_ITEMS to produce search results.
handleSearchChange debounces and invokes performSearch with the current query.
Notification dropdown click handlers call markAsRead and markAllAsRead.
The search overlay is conditionally rendered as part of the Navbar JSX.
The Bell-icon notifications dropdown is part of the Navbar render output.
The profile dropdown is rendered inside the auth-conditional section of Navbar.
The top-nav/sidebar toggle button is a child of the Navbar right-icons block.
Search results call useNavigate to route to the chosen path.
Imports Link, useLocation, and useNavigate; renders Link components for nav, profile, and admin routes.
useTheme() provides isDarkMode and toggleDarkMode for the sun/moon button.
markAsRead and markAllAsRead invoke dataService.markNotificationRead and markAllNotificationsRead.
useEffect fetches notifications via dataService.getNotifications with limit 10.
Imports Menu, X, Search, Bell, Moon, Sun, ChevronDown, User, LogOut, Settings, Crown, BarChart2, LayoutTemplate, PanelLeft for icons.
Renders the Logo component at the left side of the top bar (hidden in sidebar mode).
Admin Panel Link routes to /admin, which is the parent app hosting the ExamInfoManager route.
ExamInfoManager is the default export of the file.
STEPS drives the side-nav, the step indicator dots, and the prev/next bounds.
Component invokes fetchCategories, fetchExamInfo, handleSubmit, handleEdit, handleDelete on mount and from UI actions.
The multi-step modal is rendered conditionally on showForm inside the component.
Category tabs and exam list are part of the main render block.
Side-nav and footer dot indicator use isStepComplete(step.id) to mark progress.
apiClient.get/put/post/delete hit /api/admin/exam-categories and /api/admin/exam-info.
toast.success and toast.error are emitted on create/update/delete/validation events.
Imports useNavigate for client-side navigation.
Imports Plus, Edit, Trash2, X, Save, FileText, ExternalLink, BookOpen, Clock, Zap, Layers, ChevronRight, Check, User, Calendar, Award icons.
The route folder hosts the ExamInfoManager page; conventional Vite feature route mount point.
Admin Panel link targets /admin; ExamInfoManager lives within that admin app and is reachable from this link.
